description: Pays for a plan or product as a test member through the app's real checkout in Stripe's sandbox, with Stripe's published test card (card: visa pays, declined is declined, 3ds asks 3-D Secure) — sandbox keys only, test members only, the test kit's daily caps. When this server can't type the card itself, the answer is the sandbox checkout link and the test card for the founder to pay in their browser; test_outcome then reads the result. Nothing real is ever charged. This is what a founder may call trying a payment.
name: test_pay
title: Test a payment
